children: These disclosures are from 13Ds filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission. 13Ds are filed within 10 days of an entity's attaining more than 5% in any class of a company's securities. Subsequent changes in holdings or intentions must be reported in amended filings. This material is from Oct. 29 through Nov. 4, 2026. Source: VerityData

Group 1 Automotive (GPI) Conifer Management raised its stake in the automotive retailer to 2,012,290 shares. Conifer Management did so through the purchase of 171,592 Group 1 Automotive shares from Sept. 30 through Oct. 26 at per share prices ranging from $226 to $249.84. Following the latest purchases, Conifer Management continues to own a 16.9% stake in Group 1 Automotive's outstanding stock. Shares of Group 1 Automotive have lost roughly 30.1% of their value since the beginning of this year.

Corebridge Financial (CRBG) Nippon Life Insurance raised its stake in the retirement solutions and insurance provider to 131,262,715 shares. Nippon Life did so through the purchase of 4,658,665 Corebridge Financial shares from Oct. 5 through Oct. 23 at per share prices ranging from $32.28 to $35.58. This comes after Corebridge Financial shareholders approved a definitive merger with Equitable Holdings

back in July that is expected to close by year end. Following the latest purchases, Nippon Life owns a 29.4% stake in Corebridge Financial's outstanding stock. Shares of Corebridge Financial have gained approximately 19.4% in value in 2026.

Nano Dimension (NNDM) Murchinson raised its stake in the additive manufacturing company to 20,416,500 shares. Murchinson did so through the purchase of 416,500 Nano Dimension shares from Sept. 3 through Sept. 4 at per share prices of $1.60 to $1.62. Following the latest purchases, Murchinson owns a 10.1% stake in Nano Dimension's outstanding stock. Shares of Nano Dimension have lost roughly 15.1% of their value in 2026.

Quanex Building Products (NX) Teleios Capital Partners lowered its stake in the building products components maker to 4,022,113 shares. Teleios Capital Partners did so through the sale of 229,766 Quanex Building Products shares from Oct. 22 through Oct. 26 at per share prices ranging from $19.50 to $21.12. Following the latest sales, Teleios Capital Partners continues to own an 8.8% stake in Quanex Building Products' outstanding stock. Shares of Quanex Building Products have gained roughly 45.8% in value in 2026.

American Outdoor Brands (AOUT) Engine Capital lowered its stake in the outdoor products company to 545,324 shares. Engine Capital did so through the sale of 111,005 American Outdoor Brands shares from Sept. 29 through Oct. 7 at per share prices ranging from $16.05 to $16.96. Following the latest sales, Engine Capital continues to own a 4.3% stake in American Outdoor Brands' outstanding stock, placing Engine Capital below the 5% threshold that would require it to report further sales. Shares of American Outdoor Brands have gained roughly 124.6% in value since the beginning of this year.
